channel.title: Veille IA et cybersécurité — Yuung Kansietoko
channel.description: Articles sur l'intelligence artificielle dans la cybersécurité et failles exploitées liées à l'IA, agrégés toutes les heures depuis The Hacker News, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, Le Monde Informatique, Embrace The Red, Simon Willison, le CERT-FR et la CISA.

item.title: [SecurityWeek] The Governance Gap in Open-Weight AI and What to Do About It
item.description: Lower costs, data privacy, and greater control are driving open-weight AI adoption, but many organizations are not addressing the risks that come with it. The post The Governance Gap in Open-Weight AI and What to Do About It appeared first on SecurityWeek .

item.title: [SecurityWeek] Palo Alto Networks to Buy AI Startup Applied Compute for $4.5 Billion
item.description: The all-stock deal will give the cybersecurity company a platform for fine-tuning and running open-weight AI models in public and sovereign clouds. The post Palo Alto Networks to Buy AI Startup Applied Compute for $4.5 Billion appeared first on SecurityWeek .

item.description: Coinbase says it blocked $4.7 million in cryptocurrency transfers to scammers promoting a fake giveaway using an AI-generated deepfake of Elon Musk during a Tesla livestream that attracted more than 500,000 viewers. [...]
